sources.title: Malian diplomatic missions: visa assistant
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Mali
sources.officialityEvidence: The live diplomatiemdc.gouv.ml Ministry portal exposes a nationality and passport-type assistant, including the selectable ordinary-passport value, and returns a current traveller result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Vous n’avez pas besoin d’un visa pour vous rendre au Mali, présentez-vous avec les pièces d’identité ou passeport en vigueur dans votre pays.

policies.title: Algerian, Moroccan and Chadian ordinary passports: visa-free Mali visits
policies.summary: Mali MFA’s live assistant returns an explicit no-visa decision for the three valid nationality selections when the passport type is ordinary.
conditions: The valid nationality selections are exactly “Algérie”, “Maroc” and “Tchad”, with passport type set to “Ordinaire”.
Independent replays used France and Ghana as residence/competent-post inputs; each valid selection returned the same explicit no-visa result.
The portal publishes no short-visitor stay cap; work, residence, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, laissez-passer, special-document and final-admission rules are outside scope.
The selector is dynamic and mutable. Unknown nationality values default incorrectly to its no-visa alert: Cyprus is not listed, and invalid “Turquie”/“Turkey” must not be treated as Türkiye.
Recheck before use because the assistant has known conflicts with stronger regional and passport-government evidence for other nationalities.
